verdict.rationale: GitCafe documents an official hosted MCP server at https://git.cafe/mcp that AI tools such as Claude and ChatGPT can connect to. Read tools cover code, branches, tags, issues, PRs, reviews and CI on public repos without an account, and connected accounts can work on issues and PRs with approval and per-repository access scoping. A probe confirms the MCP docs page exists, and WebMCP support extends the same tools to browser agents. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect and use the server successfully.
